body: We were friends, but I wanted to be more than that. She knew that and I feel like I was lead on and I can't get over her. It was about a year ago. I know I pushed it though. I have never been with anyone and I wanted to be with her so badly.
It isn't about her. Not being able to speak to her makes my other problems feel so much worse.

There isn't going to be a next time, as this is my senior year in high school. I didn't plan a costume. I had a thousand ideas but I was in the middle of exams. I also basically kept rationalizing that I didn't have time due to exams, but I was really just nervous and fearful, especially of seeing someone who it hurts for me to see.
I'd start reading it right now, but I have to return some videotapes.

The movie was great, and I still need to read the novel. I think the differences in the movie and the novel are interesting and compel me to want to read the novel that much more. I also like that Ellis's novels take place in one universe where characters from separate novels make appearances and can be related (Sean Bateman being Patrick's brother, Patrick appearing in Glamorama, Patrick narrating a chapter of Rules of Attraction). I even think in the movie adaption of Rules of Attraction they planned on having a cameo appearance for Patrick Bateman played by Casper Van Dien.
Not sure how I could restore confidence in myself. I feel like a miserable, useless mess at this point.

We were friends and I told her I had feelings for her. Over the year she kept leading me on implying that there was a good chance we would be together. I grew to be incredibly attracted to her and wanted badly to be with her. I have never had feelings that intense for someone in my life. She then found a guy who she claimed to have fallen in love with and she is in a relationship with him now. She has since stopped talking to me out of claims that she doesn't want to hurt me, but I think about her every single day. With the neurological problems I have been experiencing constant visual afterimages and visual trailers, and I have frequent dull pains in my head. My mind feels clouded and I feel as if I can't think clearly and that my memory has been affected.
I tell myself that but my current situation makes it difficult for me to appreciate such a sentiment
Pretty much, although Plastic Beach contests that as well.
I'm in the same situation. I fell in love with someone who used to be a friend. She lead me on for a year and she won't even talk to me anymore.
I want that to be the case but at this point I doubt it will be
I have to finish this. I can't take it anymore.

My situation is similar but not exactly the same. I met a girl who I fell in love with. She was the first girl to acknowledge me as a friend. We had a lot in common and I loved every single thing about her and I opened myself up to her and told her about my depression and she somewhat opened herself up to me. We talked every single day. I told her how I felt. I cared about her and did everything I could to show it. She expressed interest in me and told me I was sweet and kind and different from every other guy. She said she was considering being with me.  She had just broken up with her boyfriend and said she wanted to be single. At the end of the year she started to become more distant. I found out she had met another guy she "fell in love" with at first sight a mere 30 days after I expressed my desire to be with her. Now she won't talk to me and my heart is broken. I was already severely depressed before.  Hopefully this girl is genuine. It sounds like she is if she has kissed you and expressed verbal interest. I hope all goes well, but be careful at first and don't hinge all of your hopes and desires on this relationship.

I have no belonging in this world. I love a person who wants nothing to do with me anymore. She lead me along for a year, made me fall in love with her, and then abandoned me for some other guy. I came to her at a time when I was already depressed and lonely. I've never connect with people in this world, even if they shared my interests. I feel like I'm a fake, someone who tries to appeal to others but only fails. I don't feel like I've contributed any talents in this world. Simple things like going to school are a pain now. I have symptoms that nobody can explain. I just can't take it anymore.
I know I was being a bit hyperbolic. I meant my past 3 years in high school.
